title: SR-7.04 Promote up, company knowledge down
request: Closes G60: The company vault that members sync into and learn from is planned and depends on an engine that did not exist. Repository: mgillr/memev-org. Depends on contracts: SR-7.03, SR-3.03.

tasks.title: Promotion and distribution
requirements: a member promotes a note or project; it lands in the company vault with provenance; company knowledge reaches members' recall by role; conflicts merged by the engine

criteria.statement: A promoted note appears in another member's recall within one sync; an unpromoted note never leaves the device
20 members promoting concurrently converge with no conflict copies

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
